description: Pinyin-to-Character Conversion Benchmark for Small Models
system_prompt:
**Role:** Expert Mandarin Chinese Tutor.

**CORE INSTRUCTION:**
You are a Pinyin-to-Character converter. You only process the Pinyin syllables. 
**IGNORE ALL ENGLISH WORDS.** If the input contains English (e.g., "Name," "told," "Name"), you must skip them entirely. Do not translate them. Do not map them.
- NEVER translate "Grandma", "told", "said", or any other English words.
- NEVER translate English names like "John" "Joe" "Jane" etc.

**Task 1: Literal Mapping (The "Robot" Rule)**
- Identify all Pinyin syllables).
- Map EVERY syllable to its most literal Chinese character.
- **RULE:** Do not omit any pinyin syllables (including particles).
- **RULE:** Do not "correct" a syllable unless it does not work in the sentence as written.
- **RULE:** The output must ONLY contain characters for the pinyin. Do not include characters for the names or English verbs.

**Task 2: Tutor's Note (The "Teacher" Rule)**
- Provide a "Natural Alternative" for the pinyin phrase.
- Explain the grammar/vocabulary of the literal translation.

**Output Format (Strictly Follow):**

[Phonetic Sandbox]
Literal Translation: [Characters for the Pinyin ONLY]

| Chinese | Pinyin | English |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| [Characters] | [Tone-marked Pinyin] | [Literal translation of Pinyin] |

**Tutor's Note:**
- **Grammar/Vocab:** [Brief explanation]
- **Natural Alternative:** [Your correction here] only include if there are necessary corrections

tests.title: Basic command with English context
tests.prompt: Sue told Sara qu xi shou ba
tests.expected_grammar_vocab: qù (go), xǐ (wash), shǒu (hand), ba (sentence-final particle for suggestion/command)
tests.expected_natural_alternative: 快去洗手吧 (kuài qù xǐ shǒu ba) - "Hurry up and go wash your hands"

tests.title: English names should be ignored
tests.prompt: John told Mary ni hao ma
tests.expected_grammar_vocab: nǐ (you), hǎo (good), ma (question particle)
tests.expected_natural_alternative: 你好吗？(nǐ hǎo ma?) - "How are you?"

tests.title: Multiple English words interspersed
tests.prompt: Grandma said wo yao chi fan le
tests.expected_grammar_vocab: wǒ (I), yào (want), chī (eat), fàn (rice/meal), le (completed action particle)
tests.expected_natural_alternative: 我要吃饭了 (wǒ yào chī fàn le) - "I want to eat now" / "I'm going to eat"

tests.title: Question with English context
tests.prompt: Teacher asked student zen me yang
tests.expected_grammar_vocab: zěn me (how), yàng (kind/type/sort) - together means "how is it?"
tests.expected_natural_alternative: 怎么样？(zěn me yàng?) - "How is it?" / "How are things?"

tests.title: Negative command
tests.prompt: Mom told me bu yao qu
tests.expected_grammar_vocab: bú (not - tone sandhi from bù before yào), yào (want), qù (go)
tests.expected_natural_alternative: 别去 (bié qù) - "Don't go" (more natural prohibition)

tests.title: Time expression with English
tests.prompt: Yesterday John said wo ming tian qu
tests.expected_grammar_vocab: wǒ (I), míng tiān (tomorrow), qù (go) - Chinese puts time before verb
tests.expected_natural_alternative: 我明天去 (wǒ míng tiān qù) - "I'm going tomorrow" (already natural)

tests.title: Particle 'ne' for follow-up question
tests.prompt: Jane asked ni ne
tests.expected_grammar_vocab: nǐ (you), ne (follow-up question particle, "and you?")
tests.expected_natural_alternative: 你呢？(nǐ ne?) - "And you?" / "How about you?"

tests.title: Complex sentence with 'de' particle
tests.prompt: He said ta de shu hen hao
tests.expected_grammar_vocab: tā (he), de (possessive/attributive particle), shū (book), hěn (very), hǎo (good)
tests.expected_natural_alternative: 他的书很好 (tā de shū hěn hǎo) - "His book is very good" (already natural)

tests.title: Experience particle 'guo'
tests.prompt: Friend told me wo qu guo beijing
tests.expected_grammar_vocab: wǒ (I), qù (go), guo (experience particle), běi jīng (Beijing)
tests.expected_natural_alternative: 我去过北京 (wǒ qù guo běi jīng) - "I've been to Beijing" (already natural)

tests.title: Ba particle for suggestion
tests.prompt: Sister said wo men zou ba
tests.expected_grammar_vocab: wǒ men (we), zǒu (walk/leave), ba (suggestion particle "let's")
tests.expected_natural_alternative: 我们走吧 (wǒ men zǒu ba) - "Let's go" (already natural)

tests.title: Multiple names - all should be ignored
tests.prompt: Tom told Jerry told Bob ni hao
tests.expected_grammar_vocab: nǐ (you), hǎo (good) - standard greeting
tests.expected_natural_alternative: 你好 (nǐ hǎo) - "Hello" (already natural)

tests.title: English verb 'said' with colon
tests.prompt: Alice said: wo bu zhidao
tests.expected_grammar_vocab: wǒ (I), bù (not), zhī dào (know)
tests.expected_natural_alternative: 我不知道 (wǒ bù zhī dào) - "I don't know" (already natural)

tests.title: Measure word with English context
tests.prompt: Teacher said na ge ren hen gao
tests.expected_grammar_vocab: nà (that), ge (measure word for people), rén (person), hěn (very), gāo (tall)
tests.expected_natural_alternative: 那个人很高 (nà ge rén hěn gāo) - "That person is very tall" (already natural)

tests.title: Directional complement
tests.prompt: Mom said xia lai ba
tests.expected_grammar_vocab: xià (down), lái (come - directional complement), ba (suggestion particle)
tests.expected_natural_alternative: 下来吧 (xià lái ba) - "Come down" / "Come on down" (already natural)

tests.title: Resultative complement
tests.prompt: He said kan wan le
tests.expected_grammar_vocab: kàn (watch/read), wán (finish - resultative complement), le (completed action)
tests.expected_natural_alternative: 看完了 (kàn wán le) - "Finished watching/reading" (already natural)

tests.title: Potential complement
tests.prompt: She said ting bu dong
tests.expected_grammar_vocab: tīng (listen), bù (not), dǒng (understand) - potential complement structure
tests.expected_natural_alternative: 听不懂 (tīng bù dǒng) - "Can't understand (by listening)" (already natural)

tests.title: Adverbial 'hen' with adjective
tests.prompt: Friend said ta hen mang
tests.expected_grammar_vocab: tā (he), hěn (very), máng (busy) - hěn required before adjectives in statements
tests.expected_natural_alternative: 他很忙 (tā hěn máng) - "He's very busy" (already natural)

tests.title: Comparison with 'bi'
tests.prompt: Brother said wo bi ni gao
tests.expected_grammar_vocab: wǒ (I), bǐ (compare/than), nǐ (you), gāo (tall) - comparison structure
tests.expected_natural_alternative: 我比你高 (wǒ bǐ nǐ gāo) - "I'm taller than you" (already natural)

tests.title: Passive with 'bei'
tests.prompt: She said shu bei wo kan le
tests.expected_grammar_vocab: shū (book), bèi (passive marker), wǒ (I), kàn (read), le (completed)
tests.expected_natural_alternative: 书被我看了 (shū bèi wǒ kàn le) - "The book was read by me" (already natural)

tests.title: Causative with 'rang'
tests.prompt: Teacher said lao shi rang wo qu
tests.expected_grammar_vocab: lǎo shī (teacher), ràng (make/let), wǒ (I), qù (go) - causative structure
tests.expected_natural_alternative: 老师让我去 (lǎo shī ràng wǒ qù) - "The teacher made me go" / "The teacher let me go"

tests.title: Only pinyin - no English
tests.prompt: wo ai ni
tests.expected_grammar_vocab: wǒ (I), ài (love), nǐ (you)
tests.expected_natural_alternative: 我爱你 (wǒ ài nǐ) - "I love you" (already natural)

tests.title: English with quotes
tests.prompt: He said "wo yao qu"
tests.expected_grammar_vocab: wǒ (I), yào (want), qù (go)
tests.expected_natural_alternative: 我要去 (wǒ yào qù) - "I want to go" (already natural)

tests.title: Third person 'ta' ambiguity
tests.prompt: Someone said ta qu le
tests.expected_grammar_vocab: tā (he/she/it - context dependent), qù (go), le (completed action)
tests.expected_natural_alternative: 他去了 (tā qù le) - "He/She went" (already natural)

tests.title: Plural 'men' with English
tests.prompt: They said wo men shi peng you
tests.expected_grammar_vocab: wǒ men (we), shì (is/are), péng you (friend)
tests.expected_natural_alternative: 我们是朋友 (wǒ men shì péng you) - "We are friends" (already natural)

tests.title: Modal 'hui' for future/ability
tests.prompt: He said wo hui qu
tests.expected_grammar_vocab: wǒ (I), huì (will/can - future or ability), qù (go)
tests.expected_natural_alternative: 我会去 (wǒ huì qù) - "I will go" / "I can go" (already natural)
